 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:29160  CRL.P No. 5662 of 2023  ORDER Accused No.1 in Crime No.151/2023, registered by Davanagere Rural Police Station, Davanagere for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504, 506, 109, 149 of Indian Penal Code (for short hereinafter referred to as 'IPC') is before this Court seeking anticipatory bail.
2.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned HCGP appearing for the respondent- State.

3. The case of the prosecution is that on the basis of the complaint dated 12.05.2023 lodged by one Smt.Anupama S.K., wife of the petitioner herein, FIR was registered in Crime No.151/2023 by Davanagere Rural Police for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504, 506, 508,
109 and 149 against the petitioner and five others.
In the complaint, it is averred that the complainant was married to the petitioner about 14 years back and they have a son aged about 12 years.
The petitioner is working as a teacher and the complainant is working as bus conductor.

In the complaint, it is averred that the petitioner had illicit relationship with many NC:
2023:KHC:29160 ladies and he was in the habit of abusing and assaulting the complainant who is his wife.

On 04.05.2023 when the complainant checked the mobile phone of the petitioner she came to know that the petitioner had illicit relationship with some lady and therefore on 07.05.2023 she had gone to her parents house at Siruguppa.
On 08.05.2023, the petitioner allegedly came to the parents house of the complainant at Siruguppa and abused the complainant and also assaulted her with his hand on her cheek.
When the complainant fell down, petitioner allegedly sat on her chest and tried to strangulate her and thereafter kicked on her stomach.
At that time, somebody came in a two wheeler and seeing them, the accused went away.
In respect of the incident that had taken place on 08.05.2023, complaint was lodged on 12.05.2023.
4. Apprehending arrest, the petitioner had filed Criminal Miscellaneous No.555/2023 which was rejected by I Additional District and Sessions Judge at Davanagere, vide order dated 08.06.2023.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge at Davanagere
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this Court.

The learned counsel for the petitioner reiterates the grounds urged in the petition and submits that the injuries suffered by the complainant are of simple in nature and there is delay of five days in Shivaputrappa @ Shivaputappa vs State Of Karnataka By Rural Police ... on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154455451/
2 filing of the complaint .
6.

entities.text: Shivaputrappa @ Shivaputappa vs State Of Karnataka By Rural Police
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned HCGP has seriously opposed the petition and submitted that the custody of the petitioner is necessary for interrogation and prays for dismissal of the petition.
7. As per the complaint averments, petitioner allegedly came to the parents house of the complainant at Siruguppa on 08.05.2023 and had abused and assaulted the complainant.
It is alleged that the petitioner tried to strangulate the complainant and also had kicked her on her stomach.
The material on record would go to show that the complainant had gone to the hospital on 11.05.2023 complaining about stomach ache.
In the wound certificate which is made available to this Court, it is seen that the injuries are simple in nature.
In respect of the incident which had taken place on 08.05.2023 complaint has been lodged on 12.05.2023.

As per the NC: 2023:KHC:29160 complaint averments, it is seen that the petitioner is a teacher by profession.
8.
Under these circumstances, I am of the considered view that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Hence, the following:
ORDER Criminal petition is allowed.

The respondent - police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioner in the event of his arrest in Crime No.151/2023, by Davanagere Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504, 506,
109, 149, subject to the following conditions:
a) Petitioner shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum, to the satisfaction of the Investigation Officer;
b) Petitioner shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons;
NC: 2023:KHC:29160 c) Petitioner shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses and shall co-operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon till filing of charge sheet.
d) Petitioner shall not involve himself in similar cases in future.
Sd/-
JUDGE GVP Shivaputrappa @ Shivaputappa vs State Of Karnataka By Rural Police ... on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154455451/
